title: AI Horror Art Generator
summary: Make horror art with AI: gothic paintings, folk horror, analog horror photos and ghost prints. Describe it, pick a horror style, and Flick makes it.
body_markdown:
### How do I make horror art with AI?


Describe an ordinary place, failing light and one detail that is wrong, such as a wheat field at dusk with a masked scarecrow, then pick a horror style and generate. In Flick you can then animate the image into a clip.


### How do I make AI horror art scary without gore?


Keep most of the frame dark, show just part of the threat, such as a figure in a doorway or a face above a fence, and add no blood, no gore, so the viewer fills in the rest.


### What is analog horror art?


Analog horror art imitates old found media, such as grainy flash photos, VHS frames and faded instant prints, with something wrong in an everyday scene; ask for the medium, its flaws and the one strange detail.


### Can I make a horror video from an image?


Yes. Generate the horror image first, then use it as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe one slow motion, such as fog drifting or a lantern flickering, while asking to keep the figure still.


### Is the horror art generator free?


Yes, it is free to start with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 runs on the free plan. Video models such as Seedance 2.5 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).
